title: Rider Loyalty Terms: Trip-Volume Goodwill on Cleaning and Damage Fees Level-Difference Refunds
content:
**Rule.** The trip-volume goodwill of a Cleaning and Damage Fees level-difference refund is read from the rider's trip fare charges whose charge date lies fewer than six whole calendar months before the refund date: a count at or above the high-volume trip count takes the high-volume refund goodwill; a count from the mid-volume trip count up to one less than the high-volume trip count takes the mid-volume refund goodwill; a lower count takes no trip-volume goodwill.

| Rider's trip fare charges in the window | Trip-volume goodwill on the refund |
|---|---|
| 6 or more (high volume) | $8.00 |
| 2 to 5 (mid volume) | $4.00 |
| 0 or 1 | none |

- **What is counted.** The rider's trip fare charge entries in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares); tips, cancellation or no-show fees, wait time, tolls, surcharges, adjustments and refunds on trips are not fare charges.
- **The window.** A fare charge counts when its charge date lies fewer than six whole calendar months before the refund date; one dated exactly six whole months before does not count.

The trip-volume goodwill is a fixed amount added to the level-difference refund; the total refund is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Window cases (hypothetical; refund on 11 October 2026)

| Fare charge date | Whole months before the refund date | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 12 April 2026 | 5 | yes |
| 11 April 2026 | 6 | no |

A rider with exactly 2 fare charges in the window takes $4.00; with 6, $8.00.
